accessibility.title: Equivalent Force Systems module introduction static overview
accessibility.long_description: A text-first overview of Equivalent Force Systems. Resolve and combine coplanar forces, then determine the magnitude and direction of the single resultant while preserving axis and quadrant conventions.

objective: Resolve and combine coplanar forces, then determine the magnitude and direction of the single resultant while preserving axis and quadrant conventions.
prerequisites: Use signed Cartesian components, degree-based angles, vector addition, the Pythagorean magnitude relation, and atan2 quadrant handling.

worked_example.entry_description: Resolve two coplanar forces into x and y components, sum them, and reveal the resultant magnitude and atan2 direction.

diagram_description: The planned vectors and coordinate systems will support: drag force magnitude; drag force angle in degrees; resolve each force into Cartesian components; sum selected x components; sum selected y components; compute resultant magnitude; compute atan2 resultant direction; toggle component and resultant overlays. Until v1.1.0 is published, this description and procedure map are the complete accessible fallback.
